borehole_visits: Field visits to borehole sources

Source: R/borehole_visits.R
borehole_visits.Rd

One row per field visit to a borehole during the monthly monitoring of drinking water quality in four Ugandan districts (Nakaseke, Kaabong, Kumi and Luuka), November 2024 to September 2025. Each visit records where the borehole is and a community member's remarks on the taste, smell and colour of its water. The water sample(s) taken at the visit are in samples, linked through visit_id.

Usage

borehole_visits

Format

A tibble with 477 rows and 9 variables

visit_id

Unique identifier of the field visit (one survey submission). Integer, assigned over all field visits sorted by district, date and submission time, so no id occurs in both borehole_visits and household_visits. Key for the visit_id column of samples.

date_sampled

Date of the field visit and of sample collection (YYYY-MM-DD).

region

Region of Uganda where the visit took place: Central Region, Karamoja Region, Teso Region or Busoga Region.

district

District where the visit took place: Nakaseke (Central), Kaabong (Karamoja), Kumi (Teso) or Luuka (Busoga).

community

Name of the community (village, parish or trading centre) where the visit took place, as entered by the enumerator and converted to title case.

source_name

Name of the borehole sampled. Spelling variants were merged within each district; NA where the entry was not a source name.

water_taste

Remark by a community member on the taste of the borehole water (free text; whitespace, case and obvious typos normalised, no semantic recoding).

water_smell

Remark by a community member on the smell of the borehole water (free text; whitespace, case and obvious typos normalised, no semantic recoding).

water_colour

Description of the colour of the sampled borehole water (free text; whitespace, case and obvious typos normalised, no semantic recoding).

Source

Maji Health / Whave Solutions Limited monitoring programme, field survey collected with mWater. Data provided by Cecilia Nansiimbi.
